title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the previous page). M_{g,ν} is the moduli stack over Q, and 𝔛_{g,ν} → M_{g,ν} is the universal curve. (X,x) is a pointed curve over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic 0. It descends to a subfield K ⊂ k of finite type over Q, giving K-points x ∈ 𝔛_{g,ν}(K) and ξ ∈ M_{g,ν}(K). K̄ is the algebraic closure of K in k. Grothendieck notes that passing from K̄ to k is 'homotopically trivial': the geometric fundamental groups do not change.

The objects on this page.
- M_{X,x,K} = π_1(𝔛_{g,ν,K}, x).
- N_{X,x,K} = π_1(M_{g,ν,K}, ξ).
- Γ_{K̄/K} = Gal(K̄/K).
- Π_{X,x} = π_1(X,x): the profinite surface group, the geometric fibre group.
- 𝔊_{X,x}: the geometric π_1 of the universal curve, i.e. the profinite analogue of the mapping class group of (X,x), or of π_1 of the universal Teichmüller curve.
- T_X: the profinite Teichmüller modular group, the geometric π_1 of M_{g,ν}.

Diagram (9) is the 3×3 diagram of homotopy exact sequences.
- Rows:
  - 1 → 𝔊_{X,x} → M_{X,x,K} → Γ_{K̄/K} → 1 (for 𝔛_{g,ν,K} over K);
  - 1 → T_X → N_{X,x,K} → Γ_{K̄/K} → 1 (for M_{g,ν,K} over K).
- Columns are the fibration sequences for 𝔛 → M with fibre X:
  - Π_{X,x} → 𝔊_{X,x} → T_X → 1;
  - Π_{X,x} → M_{X,x,K} → N_{X,x,K} → 1.
- The left-hand injectivity holds because of the sections and the hyperbolicity of the fibres.

Formula (10) repackages this as a three-step filtration Π ⊂ 𝔊 ⊂ M_{X,x,K}. The successive quotients are 𝔊/Π = T_X and M/𝔊 = Γ_{K̄/K}, and M/Π = N_{X,x,K}.

The NB observes that the K-rationality of (X,x) has not yet been used. Diagram (9)–(10) is simply the pull-back of the absolute situation over Q, i.e. the extensions of Γ_{Q̃/Q} by 𝔊_{X,x} ⊃ Π_{X,x} (diagram (1) earlier). The pull-back is along the restriction homomorphism (11) Γ_{K̄/K} → Γ_{Q̃/Q}. The next page makes this explicit as the fibre products (12) and the cartesian squares (13), (13'). The rational point is then to be encoded as a section of M_{X,x,K} → Γ_{K̄/K}.

Purpose. The section sets up the 'Galois–Teichmüller' framework: Gal(Q̄/Q), and Galois groups of finitely generated fields, acting on the profinite Teichmüller tower. Rational pointed curves are to be seen as sections of these extensions, in the spirit of the anabelian section conjecture in families.
errors: The map (11) Γ_{K̄/K} → Γ_{Q̃/Q} is restriction. When K is of finite type but not algebraic over Q, it is surjective onto an open subgroup, not an isomorphism. The pull-back description (12) remains correct, but it relies on the geometric π_1 of 𝔛_{g,ν} and M_{g,ν} being unchanged under the extension Q̃ ⊂ K̄ of algebraically closed fields. This holds in characteristic 0 for these stacks, but it is used implicitly.

Notational slips: the top brace in (10) reads N_{X,K} where N_{X,x,K} is meant. On the next page, (13') writes C_{X,x} on the bottom row where T_X (equal to the T_X on the top row) is meant. Note also that the upper-left corner of (13') has π_{X,x}, which should presumably be T_X.

ideas.what: 3×3 diagram of homotopy exact sequences for the universal curve over the moduli stack over a field K: surface group ⊂ geometric π_1 of the universal curve ⊂ arithmetic π_1, with quotients the profinite Teichmüller group and Gal(K̄/K)
ideas.modern_name: Outer Galois representation on profinite mapping class groups / arithmetic fundamental groups of M_{g,n}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse, 1984); developed by Ihara, Oda, Nakamura, Matsumoto, Hain–Matsumoto (1980s–2000s)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), Teichmüller tower and action of Gal(Q̄/Q); SGA1 for the homotopy exact sequence

ideas.what: The situation over a finitely generated field K is the pull-back of the absolute situation over Q along Gal(K̄/K) → Gal(Q̄/Q) (fibre products of extensions)
ideas.modern_name: Base change of arithmetic fundamental group extensions
ideas.where_published: SGA1 Exp. IX–X (homotopy exact sequence, base change)

ideas.what: Preparing to express the K-rational point x as a section of M_{X,x,K} → Γ_{K̄/K}
ideas.modern_name: Sections of arithmetic fundamental group extensions (section conjecture) in the universal family
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); Esquisse d'un programme

deep.surprise_reason: This is standard bookkeeping of homotopy exact sequences and their base change for the universal curve over M_{g,ν}. It sets up material that is well known, from the Esquisse and from Ihara/Oda/Nakamura. Nothing here is new.
transcription_corrections: Throughout, the subscript read as 'n' (Π_{X,n}, 𝔊_{X,n}, M_{X,n,K}, N_{X,n,K}) is the base point 'x': Π_{X,x}, 𝔊_{X,x}, M_{X,x,K}, N_{X,x,K}.
Insertion in the NB: '(∈ M_{g,ν}(K))', i.e. 'que ξ (∈ M_{g,ν}(K)) provient d'un pt à val. dans K'. The 'si' should read 'ξ'.
The top brace in (10) reads N_{X,K} (meaning N_{X,x,K}). The bottom braces read T_X and Γ_{K̄/K}.
'la situation (9) — (10)': the '— (10)' is an interlinear insertion.
M_{X,x,K}, N_{X,x,K} should be calligraphic 𝓜, 𝓝, as in (8) on the previous page.
